BUG FOUND AND FIXED in my own first pass: I initially trusted every recorded Edit/MultiEdit tool_use as having applied successfully. It had not always -- a real Edit call can fail in the original session (tool_result.is_error true, e.g. 'String to replace not found in file') when the agent's own mental model of the file was stale, and the transcript still records the attempt. This exact bug was hiding Page.class.js: one failed Edit (verified: a tool_use_error at cfca18c9's agent-abcd8d6fa1366d8d3.jsonl line 235) made my first pass mark the whole 60-event chain broken. Fixed by checking each Edit/Write/MultiEdit call's own paired tool_result for is_error and skipping (not counting as a break) any call the real tool itself rejected. This took the OK count from 166 to 176 files and fixed Page.class.js, Sidebar.js, LocalStorageSaver.js and AITask.js in one pass.

PAGE.CLASS.JS FOUND: a 60-event chain spanning five different sessions from 2026-08-15 through 2026-09-19 (7c6dac11, 0375cdd4, 84e34ab9, e938046a, cfca18c9), all applying cleanly once the is_error fix landed. Recovered content (51,855 bytes) contains read_raw/write_raw/clear_raw/store_key -- the Page.Store feature reset-restore's own held-back files (AITask.js, LocalStorageSaver.js, Sidebar.js) depend on. Hand-diff-verified byte-identical (SHA256 matches) via an independent from-scratch script, not the extractor itself.

ALL 176 candidates staged and validated before touching the repo: node --check on all 120 .js/.mjs files (0 failures), brace-balance on all 8 .css files (0 failures), JSON.parse on 2 .json/.jsonl files (0 failures). git-compared every one against both current disk and commit 8b4ced8e content -- all 176 were either absent or exactly at commit content, 0 conflicts with something newer.

REGRESSION CAUGHT under the hold: after writing all 176 files, all 4 required pages returned 200 but a headless Playwright check (own throwaway browser, chromium via the machine's global npm playwright install, never the owner's tabs) caught a console SyntaxError on every page: "The requested module './card.js' does not provide an export named 'web_url'". Reverted AITask.js back to its exact commit-8b4ced8e content (same pattern reset-restore used for its own 3 held-back files) and re-verified: all 4 pages load with 0 console errors. AITask.js's fully recovered text (byte-verified) is preserved in lost.jsonl's own outcome_note, not lost.

FINAL: 175 files newly written to disk (176 candidates minus AITask.js held back), verified live with 0 console errors on /, /framework/, /framework/ai/, /framework/ai/v/3/. Hold taken before the write, released only after the headless re-check passed. lost.jsonl updated in place: 175 lines flipped to outcome=restored (20 of them corrected from reset-restore's own downgraded_to_partial, with the old note preserved under prior_outcome_note; 155 were first-time outcomes on the partial/no pool), 1 line (AITask.js) set to a new outcome recovered_but_blocked with the old note preserved, 130 lines got a first-time outcome=still_gone with the specific reason (broken-edit-chain / no-anchor / no-evidence), and 24 remaining downgraded_to_partial lines were left completely untouched because this search found nothing new for them. 969 screenshot lines untouched throughout. 3 hand-diffs done independently (fresh script, not the extractor): Page.class.js, public/framework/core/Search/page.js, public/blog/doc/front.md -- all three SHA256-identical to what is now on disk.
